summary.text: Terri Hill is a Democratic delegate representing District 12A in the Maryland House of Delegates, where she has served since 2015, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A physician, she serves on the Health and Government Operations Committee.

paragraphs.text: Terri L. Hill was born in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania.
She earned a bachelor's degree from Harvard University in 1981 and an M.D. from the Columbia University College of Physicians and Surgeons in 1985.
Her career experience includes working as a physician and serving in the Maryland House of Delegates, and she has been affiliated with the Legislative Black Caucus of Maryland.
